strategy.rollbackBoundary: restore the database and Pi session directory snapshot with the old binary only before the first post-cutover business write; after that boundary roll forward only

records: legacy schema fingerprint and migration checksum
database and Pi session directory fingerprint
obsolete tables, routes, symbols and files to remove

required: Gateway is stopped and no process can write the SQLite database or Pi session directory
legacy schema fingerprint exactly matches the supported pre-cutover schema
there are no queued or running legacy Runs
every Requirement is classified exactly once
every archived DesignSession has exactly one DesignPackage
manual asset sources resolve to exactly one workspace
generated requirement baseline documents validate against artifact/requirement/v1
database and session fingerprints match the accepted CutoverReport

legacy_archived.predicate: normal Requirement with archived DesignSession and exactly one DesignPackage
legacy_archived.approval: do not create a governed ApprovalPacket or Approval
legacy_archived.designPackage: preserve as immutable document bound to MigrationAttestation
legacy_archived.baseline: create one artifact/requirement/v1 identity revision; summary and description are trim(legacy description) or title, sourceRefs is empty, and source_migration_document_id references the attestation

workflow.start: requires the first explicit human start command

pending_reentry.baseline: create one artifact/requirement/v1 identity revision; summary and description are trim(legacy description) or title, sourceRefs is empty, and source_migration_document_id references the attestation
pending_reentry.legacyFacts: preserve only in LegacyRequirementBundle; do not activate them for Readiness
pending_reentry.designSession: create a new human-governance session; never append new Attempts to the legacy shared transcript

manual_asset_source.predicate: Requirement source is manual-assets, or a scenario/usecase/function Artifact has only manual-asset Run provenance
manual_asset_source.hardPrecondition: no DesignPackage, requirement gene link, non-library Artifact kind, non-manual Run, Decision, Finding or human Approval

includes: terminal Runs, Run events and tool calls
source table row counts and ordered primary-key digests
legacyRequirementBundle.invalidJson: preserve raw text or bytes and digest; do not repair
legacyRequirementBundle.missingAttachment: record a typed anomaly and continue because the bundle is read-only
legacyRequirementBundle.runtimeAuthority: audit only; never an input to Readiness unless a later governed Task explicitly cites a reusable source revision

historicalArchive.reason: the archive predates ApprovalPacket and trusted Actor semantics

reusableAssets.workflowUse: a Task may cite one exact ReusableAssetRevision as an input source; a professional role still publishes a new Requirement Artifact revision

activeLegacyRuns.queuedOrRunning: refuse cutover; wait for completion or explicitly cancel in the old release

steps: verify the accepted CutoverReport and create a database plus Pi session directory snapshot
BEGIN IMMEDIATE and record the migration run
create target tables under temporary names and insert immutable policy, schema and actor snapshots
migrate manual asset sources to ReusableAsset aggregates
create and validate one LegacyRequirementBundle and MigrationAttestation per normal Requirement
create one Workflow per normal Requirement using legacy_archived or pending_reentry rules
create current requirement baseline revisions for every normal Requirement
copy requirement gene links and create legacy DesignPackage rows where applicable
validate classifications, row counts, primary-key digests, foreign keys, bundle digests and target invariants
drop obsolete legacy tables and columns, rename target tables and record schema_migrations checksum
COMMIT, run quick_check and foreign_key_check, then execute normal startup recovery before binding HTTP
migration.onFailure: ROLLBACK and refuse startup; do not modify the Pi session directory

web/src/baize-run-rail.ts: global and requirement-column legacy Run rail

obsoleteDatabaseSurface: mutable decisions.status and selected_option_id as write authority
legacy DesignPackage approved status as archive authority

oldClientBehavior.schemaMismatch: disable commands and require a full page reload

rollback.beforeFirstBusinessWrite: stop the new binary, restore the paired database and Pi session directory snapshot, start the old binary
notAllowed: feeding target schema to the old binary

postMigrationGates: every normal Requirement has exactly one Workflow
every Workflow is pending or archived and owns no active claim, Task, Attempt, Run, Gate or outbox job
every normal Requirement has one valid current requirement revision
every pending Workflow is pinned to the current PolicyBundle
every legacy_pre_policy archive has one LegacyRequirementBundle, MigrationAttestation and legacy DesignPackage but no governed ApprovalPacket
every manual asset source maps to exactly one ReusableAsset revision and no manual-assets Requirement remains
all source row counts and primary-key digests are covered by bundles or reusable asset mappings
the old tables, old columns, Reviewer role, reviewer Skill, legacy routes and legacy Web controls are absent
normal startup reconciliation succeeds before HTTP is bound
forbidden: synthetic governed Approval for legacy archives
automatic conversion of a legacy Run into a Task Attempt
force migration past a blocking preflight failure
